Gemini wine is very distinctive
Oct 2023 • Friends
A bar with a good atmosphere, the drink feature is the twins combination. Each set of drinks in this combination consists of two glasses of wine that look the same but have completely different blends and tastes. There are three combinations in total, with a total of six glasses, which is just right for two people to go together. The price is not low, the price of the set of six glasses is 1,200,000, and each glass is 280,000 if ordered individually.

7 contributions

Even a person who can't drink, could enjoy a couple of alcohol
Dec 2022 • Friends
A nice and cozy place where you can have for yourself a couple of drinks. Every drinks has a stoty behind that is really interesting to find out the connection between the story and the taste of the drinks. I really enjoyed the twins concept drinks so much that I ordered all from menu to try out. The drinks itself was so good, but even better when you put them side by side to compare the taste and even...the look. Seeing the different between 2 drinks in one pair of drinks, made me think that the one who created those drinks had to be very delicated and thoughful. So many things here I want to tell but you better check it out by yourself to figure out the most interesting part.
